title: Long-form text with no capped measure (line length runs past ~75 characters)

provenance.rationale: Net-new: the registry has text-wrap-balance and typography-rhythm but no rule on the reading measure. Two pioneers converge on a 45-75 / 60-75 character cap; long lines make the eye lose the next line. A rendered-scan rule (measuring rendered line length on prose blocks); medium because it needs the rendered pass, not a static token.
evidence: reference/_extracted/external/jakub-krehel-skills/skills/better-typography/SKILL.md: Cap the measure. Long lines make it hard for the eye to find the next one. Cap long-form text around 60-75 characters per line.
reference/_extracted/external/oracle/reference/typeset.md: Keep prose in the 45-75ch range. Tune line height inversely with measure.

errors: rule typography.measure-uncapped declares rendered-scan evidence but is missing from RENDERED_BACKED_RULE_IDS (it would never be promoted-required or fail-closed)
